title: Bevel more features
description: A left-aligned title and lead over a stack of pale 24px-rounded tabs, with a phone (and a soft shadow under it) on the right. The active tab is full size and a thin ring beside it fills while the section is in view before handing over to the next; the others sit shrunk to 93% and half faded, brightening on hover. The stack fades out at its foot. On phones the tabs turn into a sideways-scrolling row above the phone.
notes: needs JavaScript for the tab switching (hydrate: visible)
under reduced motion the tabs don't advance on their own
